text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In front of Reporter Otonashi and the rest of the media, Director Akikawa announces the creation of a new race: the URA Finale!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to enter, my trainee has to become a star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Can we claim the honor of being the first Finale Champion?
